home__description: He is a Master’s student in Computer Science at New York University and a Software Engineer Intern at TikTok, specializing in machine learning, data engineering, and software development.
about__description: Hi, my name is Hongdao Meng, a Master’s student in Computer Science at NYU with experience in both machine learning and software engineering. I’ve worked on projects ranging from building a deepfake detection platform that supported thousands of users, to developing a RAG-based chatbot system that improved both accuracy and latency, and designing large-scale infrastructure at TikTok’s recommendation system team that boosted operator migration throughput by over 95%. I’m proficient in Python, Java, and C++, with experience across frameworks like PyTorch, React, and Django, and cloud platforms like AWS and Kubernetes. I also published first-author research on federated learning in IEEE Transactions on Big Data. Overall, I’m passionate about applying AI and scalable system design to build high-performance applications that make a real impact.
